material: Recycled stainless steel with replaceable coconut-carbon lid filter
description: Odor-sealed bin for collecting fruit peels tea leaves and coffee grounds
waste_risk: Fruit flies if charcoal filter is saturated or bin is unwashed
design_opportunity: Empty into community or garden compost bin every 2 days and rinse with soapy water
tradeoff: Diverts 40% of household wet weight away from methane-producing landfills

material: Devulcanized or strip-woven scrap car tire rubber
description: Heavy-duty weatherproof entrance mat diverted from automotive tire piles
waste_risk: Slight rubber smell during the first week if used in unventilated indoor rooms
design_opportunity: Place on covered porch or balcony entrance and hose off dirt with water
tradeoff: Gives a 15-year second life to tough vulcanized rubber waste

material: FSC rubberwood or birch plywood with steel hex bolts
description: Furniture designed to be disassembled and re-tightened across 10+ hostel or apartment moves
waste_risk: Particleboard alternatives crumble at screw holes after a single move
design_opportunity: Use solid wood or threaded metal inserts so bolts never strip the wood grain
tradeoff: Flat-pack shipping plus lifetime repairability

material: Urea-formaldehyde resin woodchips and melamine plastic veneer
description: Low-cost flat-pack desk that swells when wet and strips at cam-locks
waste_risk: Moisture from a spilled glass or moving disassembly snaps the chipboard joints
design_opportunity: Reinforce joints with L-brackets or buy secondhand solid wood study tables
tradeoff: Resin-glued woodchips cannot be composted or cleanly recycled

material: Stainless steel barrel with piezo crystal igniter
description: Battery-free spark igniter for gas stoves lasting 30000+ clicks
waste_risk: Disposable plastic butane lighters are landfilled as hazardous pressurized waste
design_opportunity: Keep piezo tip dry from curry splatters to maintain strong spark generation
tradeoff: Zero butane gas or battery required for years of daily cooking

material: POM plastic tank steel wheel and pressurized butane
description: Cheap disposable flame lighter without refill valve
waste_risk: Non-refillable tank with residual gas is a fire hazard in waste compactors
design_opportunity: Switch to a refillable metal butane torch or USB arc/piezo igniter
tradeoff: Over 1.5 billion disposable lighters end up in landfills annually

material: Unfired and kiln-baked porous alluvial clay
description: Traditional evaporative-cooling earthen water pot with tap
waste_risk: Hairline cracks if bumped with metal pots or scrubbed with chemical soap
design_opportunity: Clean only with warm water and baking soda and place on a stable iron stand
tradeoff: Cools water naturally without electricity or refrigerants and returns to soil

material: Thick platinum-cured food-grade silicone
description: Washable pinch-seal bag for marinating freezing and travel toiletries
waste_risk: Pinch seal track can trap crumbs if not turned inside-out to wash
design_opportunity: Turn inside-out over a glass to dry completely after washing
tradeoff: Replaces 300+ single-use LDPE zip bags per pouch

product_name: Modular repairable power strip with surge fuse
material: Flame-retardant polycarbonate brass busbars and replaceable ceramic fuse
description: Heavy-duty extension board with standard screws and replaceable surge fuse
waste_risk: Cheap riveted power strips must be thrown away when a ₹5 internal fuse blows
design_opportunity: Unscrew the fuse cap to swap a blown glass/ceramic fuse in 60 seconds
tradeoff: Protects expensive laptops while preventing premature e-waste
